title: GPU OOM auto-fallback and kernel hard-fail handling
description:
## Goal

Wire OOM auto-fallback (CPU stage substitution + `tracing::warn`)
and kernel / driver hard-fail (diagnostic dump + non-zero exit)
across the GPU stages.

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages for gf2-sim pipeline)
within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Fault-injection test: simulated OOM triggers CPU
  fallback + `tracing::warn`; simulated kernel error hard-fails
  with diagnostic dump including HIP error code, last kernel
  launch args, device ID.
- [hard] CLI flag (e.g. `--strict-gpu`) overrides OOM
  auto-fallback to hard-fail.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
